# Assessment Overview

This document provides navigation links to all supplementary analysis documents generated as part of the PhotoAlbum application assessment.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [Architecture Diagram](./architecture-diagram.md) | Two-layer architecture visualization: application layer diagram with technology stack summary and component relationship diagram with inventory |
| [Dependency Map](./dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external dependencies grouped by functional category, including version and compatibility risks |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](./api-service-contracts.md) | Catalog of all API endpoints, service communication patterns, DTOs, security posture, and sequence diagram of primary request flows |
| [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](./data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, entity model (ER diagram), repository methods, caching strategy, and data classification/sensitivity |
| [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](./configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of all configuration sources, runtime profiles, properties, secrets workflow, and framework versions |
| [Core Business Workflows](./business-workflows.md) | End-to-end business process documentation including domain entities, primary workflows, and business rules |
